name: thermosyphon_hx
title: Thermosyphon (heat-pipe) tube-bank heat exchanger with ESDU operating limits
summary: Crossflow heat-pipe heat exchanger: flue gas over the evaporator bank, water boiling/condensing inside each thermosyphon (ESDU pool/film resistances, vapour pressure drop, axial wall conduction), boiling Cyclopentane over the condenser bank, ESDU operating limits per row, marching solution over 61 tube rows. Translation of the LaboThapPy HexThermosyphon.

verification.summary: Not verified end-to-end (failing). Row companion, corrected (unit errors) and solved with CoolSolve branch fix/ad-pow-negative-base + Try Harder: single-phase rows 1 and 61 match an instrumented re-run of the LaboThapPy example within 0.6 % (tube heat, T_HP_h, HTCs); the two-phase row 31 does not converge (CHF-based boiling closure of the source).
verification.reference: hex_thermosyphon_example.py re-run in a throw-away venv (CoolProp 8.0.0): cold outlet 516.861 K, hot outlet 543.364 K, sum Q_dot_row 5.869 MW; standalone procedure checks against CoolProp 8.1.0-dev
verification.notes: Review 2026-11-01: (1) SingularJacobian at iteration 0 = CS-BUG-PROC-NEG-POW (NaN AD derivative of log10(pL)^2 in RadHTC_FG), fixed on CoolSolve branch fix/ad-pow-negative-base; the old 'singular equation a_g' reading came from a garbled Jacobian dump (also fixed there). (2) Unit errors corrected in both files (in2ph K vs C, ExtConvBoil wall temperature, cp_wf/cp_H/cp_h_m/rho_h_out/cp_h_exit, cold BankHTC inputs of the companion; rho_wf_in at the outlet; companion u_h = 6.718 m/s of the source run). (3) Two-phase rows: h = q_CHF/(T_w - T_sat) makes the cold-side heat flow independent of the wall temperature (degenerate Jacobian); fsolve copes, CoolSolve does not. Row 1: 1259.9 vs 1261.4 W/tube, T_HP_h 626.10 vs 626.19 K; row 61: 938.9 vs 944.0 W. Source quirks (nozzle continuity, cp_H from the wrong AbstractState) in README.

diagnosis: Review 2026-11-01: CoolSolve bug CS-BUG-PROC-NEG-POW (fixed on branch fix/ad-pow-negative-base) + translation unit errors (corrected) + degenerate two-phase rows of the source (CHF used as the operating heat flux: cold-side equation loses its wall-temperature dependence). Single-phase rows reproduce the source within 0.6 %. Options: keep failing, or adapt the boiling HTC (would make the model 'modified').

history.action: review of the failing models: root cause of the iteration-0 SingularJacobian found (CS-BUG-PROC-NEG-POW, fixed on CoolSolve branch fix/ad-pow-negative-base); translation unit errors corrected in both files; row-companion inputs/initials from an instrumented source re-run; single-phase rows verified within 0.6 %; stays failing (two-phase rows)
